questions.question: What cohort underpinned the integrated 3D-genome and expression analysis?

options.A: Eighteen newly diagnosed T-ALL patients and four healthy T-cell controls
options.B: Fourteen T-ALL patients and eighteen healthy controls
options.C: Eighteen relapsed T-ALL cases and four B-cell controls
options.D: Seven ETP cases and eleven non-ETP cases without healthy controls

questions.rationale: The study integrates Hi-C and RNA-seq in 18 newly diagnosed cases with four healthy T-cell controls.
questions.evidence_quote: Here, we report integrated analyses of 3D genome alterations and differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in 18 newly diagnosed T-ALL patients and 4 healthy T cell controls.

questions.question: What fraction of all differentially expressed genes was associated with 3D-genome alterations, and how did this differ from the fraction of upregulated genes linked to those alterations?

options.A: About 29% of DEGs (996/3392), versus about 45% of upregulated genes
options.B: About 45% of DEGs (996/3392), versus about 29% of upregulated genes
options.C: About 20% of DEGs, versus 56% of all upregulated genes
options.D: About 66% of DEGs, versus 78% of upregulated genes

questions.rationale: The paper reports 996 of 3392 DEGs at about 29%, while the analysis estimates 3D changes associate with about 45% of upregulated genes.
questions.evidence_quote: Approximately 29% (996/3392) of the DEGs were associated with 3D genome alterations

questions.question: How did the Hi-C loop landscape distinguish ETP from non-ETP T-ALL, and how strongly did loop/domain changes track expression?

options.A: ETP had 1,820 enhanced and 831 reduced loops; expression changes correlated with combined loop-strength and D-score changes at r=0.685
options.B: ETP had 831 enhanced and 1,820 reduced loops; the correlation was r=0.0685
options.C: Non-ETP had 1,820 enhanced loops and no reduced loops; expression correlation was negative
options.D: The groups had identical loop counts, with expression correlated only to compartment switches

questions.rationale: The authors report markedly more enhanced than reduced loops in ETP and a positive gene-expression/structure correlation of 0.685.
questions.evidence_quote: identified 1820 enhanced and 831 reduced loops in ETP

questions.question: What did the study find about the location and architecture of newly detected translocations?

options.A: It identified 46 translocations in 14/18 samples; 34 were novel, and 47% of 78 unique breakpoints lay in noncoding regions
options.B: It identified 34 translocations in all 18 samples; 46 were novel and 47% of breakpoints were coding
options.C: It identified 44 translocations in 14/18 samples; 26 were novel and most breakpoints lay in B compartments
options.D: It identified 78 translocations, all interchromosomal, with 66% in noncoding regions

questions.rationale: Hi-C breakfinder analysis found 46 events, including 34 novel translocations; breakpoint annotation showed nearly half of the 78 unique breakpoints were noncoding.
questions.evidence_quote: we identified 46 translocations in 14/18 T-ALL samples

questions.question: What structural feature characterized the newly detected translocation-mediated loops?

options.A: Forty-four loops formed across translocated chromosomes, and nearly 78% with CTCF motifs linked convergently oriented motif pairs
options.B: Forty-six loops formed within chromosomes, and 34% linked divergent CTCF motifs
options.C: Forty-four loops were all anchored at promoters and lacked CTCF motifs
options.D: Twenty-six loops formed across chromosomes, with 47% linking convergent CTCF sites

questions.rationale: The study identifies 44 new interchromosomal loops and reports that almost 78% of those with CTCF motifs connect convergent motif orientations, consistent with loop extrusion.
questions.evidence_quote: nearly 78% of the translocation-mediated loops with CTCF motifs were linked to pairs of convergently orientated CTCF motifs

questions.question: How did the authors distinguish cis enhancer hijacking from trans-mediated activation of T-ALL transcription factors?

options.A: Cis events formed new loops bringing enhancers such as BCL11B/TRB enhancers to ectopic genes; trans events involved gene fusions that epigenetically activated HOXA
options.B: Cis events were gene fusions across chromosomes; trans events were local enhancer loops at the same locus
options.C: Cis events required CTCF loss, whereas trans events involved enhancer deletion
options.D: Cis activation occurred only in non-ETP disease, while trans activation occurred only in healthy T cells

questions.rationale: The paper uses enhancer hijacking through translocation-mediated loops as the cis mechanism and fusion-driven epigenetic activation as the trans mechanism.
questions.evidence_quote: The "cis" mechanism involved translocation-mediated enhancer hijacking in the ETP, TLX and TAL subtypes

questions.question: What distinguished 5′HOXA-positive cases from 3′HOXA-positive cases in expression and TAD-boundary usage?

options.A: 5′HOXA cases showed ectopic HOXA11–A13 expression and commonly used C7/9 as the 3′-TAD boundary, whereas most 3′HOXA cases used C10/11
options.B: 5′HOXA cases expressed HOXA1–A10 and used C10/11, whereas 3′HOXA cases expressed HOXA11–A13 and used C7/9
options.C: Both groups used C11/13 as the only boundary and differed only in total HOXA expression
options.D: 5′HOXA cases lacked all translocations, whereas every 3′HOXA case had a BCL11B fusion

questions.rationale: The authors separate HOXA-positive cases by 3′ versus 5′ gene-expression patterns and associate the groups with different boundary choices in the 3′ TAD.
questions.evidence_quote: C7/9 was used by most of the HOXA -(6/8) and all 5'HOXA + samples (2/2), while C10/11 was used by most of the 3'HOXA + samples (4/5)

questions.question: Which translocation-associated event explained ectopic HOXA11–A13 expression in sample 108?

options.A: An inter-TAD inversion enabled adoption of active CDK6 enhancers and new loop formation
options.B: A BCL11B-TLX3 fusion directly activated HOXA1–A10
options.C: A TRB-TAL2 enhancer loop insulated HOXA13 from its native TAD
options.D: A PSIP1-NUP98 fusion repositioned the 3′ TAD boundary at C11/13

questions.rationale: In case 108, an inversion altered TAD contacts and allowed the HOXA cluster to use CDK6-associated enhancers, producing ectopic HOXA11–A13.
questions.evidence_quote: For the case of 108, the inter-TAD inversion led to the adoption of active CDK6 enhancers and new loop formation

questions.question: Which HOXA genes, unlike other cluster members including HOXA9, were associated with poor overall and event-free survival?

options.A: HOXA11 or HOXA13 positivity, alone or combined
options.B: HOXA1 or HOXA4 positivity, alone or combined
options.D: Any HOXA-cluster expression regardless of the specific gene

questions.rationale: Outcome analysis singled out HOXA11/13 but not HOXA9 or other genes; HOXA13 positivity was also an independent predictor of overall survival in multivariate analysis.
questions.evidence_quote: HOXA11 or HOXA13 positivity, alone or in combination, but not the expression of other HOXA genes, such as the previously used biomarker HOXA9, was associated with poor overall and event-free survivals

questions.question: What analytical resolution strategy did the investigators use to assign translocation breakpoints from BL-Hi-C data?

options.A: They treated 150-bp reads as single ends and required more than three chimeric reads at a precise location for breakpoint support
options.B: They paired 40-kb reads and accepted any single chimeric read near a known breakpoint
options.C: They used RNA-seq split reads only and called breakpoints at 100-kb resolution
options.D: They mapped 5-kb reads to CTCF motifs and assigned every translocation to a TAD boundary

questions.rationale: The high sequencing depth and 150-bp reads allowed single-end treatment to refine breakpoints; locations supported by more than three chimeric reads were reported at base-pair resolution.
questions.evidence_quote: the exact locations (single base-pair resolution) supported by more than 3 chimeric reads were identified as the actual breakpoints
